verdict.rationale: incident.io documents its own Insights feature. It supports configurable Week/Month/Quarter ranges and a toggle to compare against the previous period, which supports trend tracking. The evidence never says which metrics Insights reports, so MTTA/MTTR, incident load and on-call health are only implied. missing for 10: explicit MTTA/MTTR trend metrics, incident load/volume reporting, on-call health or burden analytics, independent or hands-on corroboration.
